channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kobe Bryant | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kobe Bryant from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
Giannis Antetokounmpo:

“The only picture I got is with Kobe Bryant. But like, when I went there, I had a notebook. I had a notebook and I asked him like 50 questions. I got that notebook right here in my house. Whenever I get confused, whenever I don't have the answer, I go back to that notebook. I'm like, okay, what did he say here? I have that knowledge in a notebook.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Kobe Bryant, Oct 8, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Matt Barnes on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
Matt Barnes on the fallout from his incident with Kobe Bryant:

“I got death threats, hate mail, you can't come to LA, we going to kill you. All kinds of crazy sh*t. He called me in that off-season and told me, anyone crazy enough to fuck with me is crazy enough to play with me. And I became a Laker that following season. But it was almost like, okay, I may not be a bad person off the court, but I'm almost a villain on the court. Let me embrace that. So I embraced that villain role like halfway through my career.”

Matt Barnes on Kobe Bryant, Oct 8, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
Mark Cuban:

“Early on after I bought the team, I think it was my second year. We hadn't beat the Lakers in LA in like 12 years or something crazy. Andwe were up 30 going into the fourth quarter and I'm thinking, yeah boy, we got this. Who loses a 30-point lead? I never seen that. Kobe Bryant got hot and it was over. It was the worst, it was the worst.”

Mark Cuban on Kobe Bryant, Oct 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
Bam Adebayo on Kobe Bryant fans wanting him to stop at 81 points:

“I went for it. I knew exactly what I was doing. I don’t give a f*ck about what anybody negative has to say. — People say ‘you should’ve stopped at 81!’ Why? So y’all can never mention me? I already know how Kobe fans are. I’m a Kobe fan!”

Bam Adebayo on Kobe Bryant, Oct 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Trevor Ariza on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
Trevor Ariza on Kobe Bryant:

“I had just got signed to go to Houston, and it was preseason, so I'm watching the games or whatever. So I take a picture of that clip right there, and I send it to him. And he laughed. He said that means if I miss, somebody should have an easy put back. He was always say sh*t like that. Like always say like little things that would kind of make you like, what are you talking about? Buthe was serious. And like he ended up being all of those things that he said he was going to be.”

Trevor Ariza on Kobe Bryant, Sep 26, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kwame Brown on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
Kwame Brown:

“He was terrified of girls after that situation. And he is Kobe Bryant, so he can't even get close to a female because if they do, the tabloids can make it into something that is not. So it would be fans that want a picture because it is female, he can't even say anything to her. He got to walk by. I am like, your life got to suck. I am the bus, but I can talk to all these girls and have a good time. You know, so I am like, so we can't have these girls over and have a drink and you not doing anything and we like, we can't just chill? He was like, no. And I am just sitting there chopping it up with him and I am just listening to his life and I am like, man, that is terrible.”

Kwame Brown on Kobe Bryant, Sep 19, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Richard Jefferson on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Bill Russell
item.description:
Richard Jefferson:

“There is no GOAT in basketball because there's multiple levels. Kareem Abdul-Jabbar I think had the greatest career, Bill Russell won the most championships, Michael Jordan is the icon, and I think Kobe Bryant and what he did mentally for the game and really for athletes all around the world. ButI would just say if you were to build a basketball player, you could not build a better basketball player than LeBron James. There's no skill set he doesn't have, there's no physical ability. So for me, if I was building a basketball player, mentally and physically, he would be the person that I would build.”

Richard Jefferson on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Bill Russell, Sep 12, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
“I’m like, yeah, okay, because I’m trying to sign. He was talking about Kobe Bryant.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Kobe Bryant, Aug 28, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Bob Myers on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
Bob Myers:

“Kobe, my first day in that office with Arn (Tellem), I went in to interview to be an intern, and Kobe was sitting in that little lounge area they had. You know this, and he was sitting on the couch, and he had a Joe Montana retro jersey, 49ers, number 16. And I literally walked in, he was the first person I saw, because you know that little lounge was right there, there was no security, there was just Kobe Bryant. And they had just lost to Utah when he missed those shots. And this dude was so confident. I said, hey, I'd like to meet you, and he started talking. And he said,I'm going to win 10 NBA championships, and then I'm going to finish my career in Italy.”

Bob Myers on Kobe Bryant, Aug 27, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Olden Polynice on LeBron James, Rich Paul, Kobe Bryant
item.description:
Olden Polynice on Rich Paul saying Kobe Bryant would have supported LeBron James’ decision to join Philly:

“This goes out to Rich Paul. I have nothing but respect for you as far as how what you’ve accomplished and how you got there. You worked your butt off. But you need to shut the fu*k up with that statement because that is the most asinine thing. Number one, we don’t know. You shouldn’t bring up Kobe in any way, shape, or form that he would know what you know, LeBron, you know, the decision LeBron made. That’s some bullsh*t, Okay. This is clickbait all over again. That’s like me walking up and slapping somebody and going, Malcolm X would have understood it. I don’t know what the hell Malcolm X would understand. And so to me, don’t do that. That’s so disrespectful.”

Olden Polynice on LeBron James, Rich Paul, Kobe Bryant, Aug 3, 2026. Source: Apple Podcasts.

item.title: Jalen Brunson on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
NBA Courtside:Jalen Brunson on Kobe Bryant mentality:

“I think the way I carry myself and way I do things, it’s a credit to how I was raised by my parents. But also part of their philosophy steeps into the Mamba mentality as well. So there’s a connectivity there. I do my best to stay present in the moment and do everything I can to make sure my mind is right. Be mentally and physically ready everyday. Trusting my work. It’s what’s gotten me here. So there’s connectivity about it”

Jalen Brunson on Kobe Bryant, Jun 7, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Mike Krzyzewski on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant
item.description:
Mike Krzyzewski on coaching the USA team:

“I coached the US teams for 11 years and I told them, when we started off every team bring your egos in. I don’t believe in leave your egos at the door. That’s suchBS. I want you to be who you are. And by the way, Kobe Bryant, LeBron, they would have they would have brought their damn egos in no matter what the hell anyway. But I would always tell them, I said, if you can all put your egos under one ego umbrella,call it USA, we’ll kick everyone’s a**. You know, we’ll rule the world.”

Mike Krzyzewski on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Mar 17, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Brandon Ingram on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Brandon Ingram on having the ball in his hands in clutch situations, like he did on Friday:

“It's what we work for. It's what we dream of, growing up having idols like Kobe Bryant. We relish those moments right there. I get excited for it.”

Brandon Ingram on Kobe Bryant, Oct 20, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Austin Rivers on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Kevin Durant, Carmelo Anthony, Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, James Harden
item.description:
Fullcourtpass: Austin Rivers on scoring in the NBA

“LeBron James doesn’t have half the offensive bag that Kevin [Durant]has…I would say Kevin Durant, Carmelo Anthony, James Harden, Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, and Allen Iverson are the best scorers I’ve ever seen”

Austin Rivers on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Kevin Durant, Carmelo Anthony, Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, James Harden, Aug 13, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
Kyrie Irving:

“I'm not going down into detail about this, because what's said on the internet is said on the internet. But when it comes to real respect and real recognizing real, this man Kobe Bean Bryant is immortalized—not just because of his basketball. That's what I'm trying to tell y'all—this man is immortal. He's way bigger because of the character, because of what we witnessed him go through.”

Kyrie Irving on Kobe Bryant, Jul 23, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
Kyrie Irving on Kobe Bryant:

“I'm not letting people revise history. I'm not letting people come on and talk about Kobe like Kobe wasn't one of the best—not only that played, but that came in as a 17-year-old against grown men. And by the time this man was 22 years old, he had a few championships, and he was busting the best of the best's ass.”

Kyrie Irving on Kobe Bryant, Jul 23, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Danny Green on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
Which isn’t to say Green doesn’t also appreciate Thunder star Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, the Canadian who won league MVP this year.

“I love the fact that he still, he reminds me of Kobe (Bryant). He still does a lot in the mid-range and a lot of footwork and fundamentals,”

Danny Green on Kobe Bryant, Jun 4, 2025. Source: Toronto Sun.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
“Kobe Bryant wasn’t wearing the same shoe that you go buy. But, you’re wearing the same exact shoe that I wear.”

Jaylen Brown on Kobe Bryant, May 25, 2025. Source: Celtics Blog.

item.title: Donald Trump on Kobe Bryant, Tiger Woods, Martin Luther King, Muhammad Ali
item.description:
This was where he mentioned Bryant as one of the national figures.

“Martin Luther King Jr., Muhammad Ali. Not a bad athlete, what do you think, Muhammad, not too bad, and the late Kobe Bryant. People love Kobe Bryant. We're going to save Tiger Woods for another time,”

Donald Trump on Kobe Bryant, Tiger Woods, Martin Luther King, Muhammad Ali, Feb 20, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Lonzo Ball on Kobe Bryant, Stephen Curry
item.description:
Lonzo Ball:

“I love Kobe Bryant, but he was never the best player to me when I was watching him. Just because he’s got the most misses ever, you know what I’m saying? I don’t know. But back to Curry—his resume, the way he changed the game—he’s the best shooter ever. Carried USA. There ain’t nothing that he hasn’t done, and he’s got the rings to back it up too. So, I don’t know.”

Lonzo Ball on Kobe Bryant, Stephen Curry, Nov 28, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
But a few years ago, after shooting 80-plus percent from the free-throw line through his first four seasons, Towns did what many creatures of habit wouldn’t dare to: he changed up his routine.

“I was watching Kobe (Bryant), the way he was shooting, the way he was minimizing energy used at the free-throw line,”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Kobe Bryant, Nov 4, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: John Salley on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
John Salley:

“So, Kobe's sitting there at the bar in Miami, not drinking, and this girl goes, 'Kobe Bryant!' All the girls turn, rush him, and he's polite, just sitting there. They finally dwindle down, andhe turns to me, says, 'I'm ready to leave.' I said, 'Damn, you didn’t get even one?' He goes, 'No, I got to train in the morning.' I was like, 'Kobe, we're in Miami.' He just looked at me and said, 'I got a 6 a.m. session.' He was there alone, just focused. It blew my mind.”

John Salley on Kobe Bryant, Nov 1, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Brandon Jennings on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant
item.description:
Brandon Jennings:

“I don't have MJ in my Top 5 because when I was seven or eight years old, that was the last time he won a championship. I didn’t really understand basketball like that, so I didn’t really start loving the game until I saw AI and Kobe Bryant in the early 2000s. That’s why he can’t be in my Top 5.I respect him, I can watch his highlight tape, but what I really saw and felt were guys like Steph Curry, LeBron James, Kobe, Shaq, and KD.”

Brandon Jennings on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Oct 22, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: LeBron James on Kobe Bryant, D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
“D’Angelo is a playmaker that’s used to having the ball in his hands but you have to understand that’s not your role anymore. I’m talking about D’Angelo Russell now. You have to become a spot up shooter when you’re playing with a guy like LeBron James; almost like I had to play when I was playing with Kobe Bryant. But again, you have to know how to adapt to your teammates and that’s what good basketball players do, you know? You know what your role is on certain teams and then elevate your game to that level that it needs to be.”

LeBron James on Kobe Bryant, D'Angelo Russell, Oct 8, 2024. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
Kyrie Irving on his relationship with his mentor, Kobe Bryant:

“I miss him every single day … because he held such a big presence and he knew what his superpowers were …Everyday he walks with me in spirit and I feel his presence every day.”

Kyrie Irving on Kobe Bryant, Jun 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Kobe Bryant, Aaron Gordon
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Rudy Gobert on Aaron Gordon going 11-for-12:

“A lot of them were contested so if Gordon turns into Kobe Bryant, we just got to live with that”

Rudy Gobert on Kobe Bryant, Aaron Gordon, May 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
He explained his stance on his podcast with featured guest and former NBA player JJ Redick.

“The only thing I don't like about the [GOAT] conversation is they don't put my boy [Kobe Bryant] in it. If you're gonna be throwing names around, you gotta have my boy's name in it. That's like saying, ‘What are the best luxury cars out there? Lexus or Beemer?' You gotta put the Mercedes in there too,”

Shaquille O'Neal on Kobe Bryant, May 7, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
“You never think it could happen to players like Kobe Bryant or even to me. It's just such a career-ending injury.”

Kevin Durant on Kobe Bryant, Apr 26, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Gary Vitti on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
Gary Vitti:

“The biggest and most superlative sweet moment of Kobe Bryant is when you’d see him with a Make-a-Wish kid. That’s a difficult and emotional thing. Most people, to be honest with you, don’t want to do it. But they will do it because it’s the right thing to do. Kobe almost relished in it. He was really, really good with these kids. You never got the feeling that he was one foot out the door and wanted to get it over with. He talked to them like they weren’t sick. To me, these were the highlights of being around him as that guy.”

Gary Vitti on Kobe Bryant, Feb 8, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Jordan Hawkins on Kobe Bryant
item.description:
“That’s what he (Bryant) was. He had the game to back it up as well. When you have that type of work ethic and that type of game, you can show your confidence and not think it’s cocky or anything. Just believing in yourself.”

Jordan Hawkins on Kobe Bryant, Feb 7, 2024. Source: New Orleans Times-Picayune.
